entry.title: Compare Foundry models
entry.why: Compare model purpose, deployment options and lifecycle before selecting one.
entry.status: Vendor documentation; model listing does not imply tenant availability or approval.

briefing.purpose: Orient a model choice in Microsoft Foundry.
briefing.inputs: Intended task, modality, region, deployment route and usage constraints.
briefing.approach: Use the linked guide to reach current model cards; inspect provider, lifecycle, region, deployment, support and terms.
briefing.outputs: A model candidate and the tenant-specific checks still needed.
briefing.requirements: Foundry access and the relevant project, quota and permissions for deployment or use.
briefing.limits: A model is not an MCP tool. Catalog presence does not establish organizational approval, entitlement, deployment or fit.
briefing.review_scope: Official model-catalog overview inspected; no tenant models or deployments tested.
